# Team invite designs (fixture, text description of 6 frames)

1. "Team settings": member list, button "Invite member".
2. "Invite modal": email field, role dropdown (Admin, Member), button "Send invite", "Cancel".
3. "Invite sent toast": toast "Invite sent to <email>" over Team settings.
4. "Accept invite": text "You've been invited to join Acme", button "Accept and continue".
5. "Team dashboard": welcome banner, team projects.
6. "Upgrade plan": pricing cards, button "Upgrade". No frame or requirement links to this screen.
